instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Social enterprise providing employment training and job placement services for refugees and marginalized communities. Operates 3 training centers and a social enterprise catering business that provides work experience. Placed 800 individuals into employment in the past year. Evaluating skills-gap matching algorithms and digital training delivery for remote participants. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 2 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Digital Skills Mapping and Supply Chain Integration
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the launched inventory digitalization project to connect supply chain bottlenecks directly to skills gaps in placed individuals. This requires a radical upgrade of the existing skills-gap matching algorithms to predict future workforce needs based on material flow data, maximizing efficiency gains.

first_actions: Conduct a cross-functional audit mapping top 3 failing supply chain links against required job roles/skills.
Develop compliance protocols for handling combined operational and personal performance data (regulatory requirement).
Pilot the enhanced AI matching algorithm on one specific product line to test predictive accuracy.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in skills mismatch complaints by 20% within 6 months.
milestones: Complete data integration roadmap between ERP and HR systems.
Finalize AI model beta testing results.
Launch pilot dashboard with functional KPIs.

opportunities.title: Streamlined Governance for Rapid Innovation Funding (Internal Market)
opportunities.rationale: The core barrier is the rigid, multi-stakeholder business case approval process. Create an internal 'Innovation Sandbox' governance model where small, high-ROI projects can bypass standard annual planning cycles and get rapid micro-funding based on demonstrated early traction metrics.

first_actions: Design a simplified 3-step funding request protocol for projects < $50k (time reduction focus).
Establish clear compliance guidelines for accepting 'sandbox' financial risks.
Secure executive sponsorship from the board to pilot the new governance structure.
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease in average time-to-funding approval for small projects from 90 days to under 30 days.
milestones: Draft and validate the Sandbox charter.
Measure success by project launch velocity.

next_steps.action: Formalize the process and owner for calculating ROI thresholds (<12 months) across all departments to ensure data consistency.
Develop a detailed scope and requirements document for the inventory digitalization project, focusing on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to margin pressure.
Initiate a workshop with cross-functional leaders to map out the ideal, friction-free workflow for mid-cycle funding requests.

key_weaknesses: Structural rigidity in annual planning and internal resource allocation (major bottleneck).
Dependence on informal customer feedback channels, lacking centralized data capture.
Cross-functional leadership structure is functional but lacks a unified operational mandate for rapid change.

improvements: Successfully launched digital onboarding flow, significantly reducing time and improving NPS scores.
Initiated inventory digitalization project to address supply chain visibility and margin pressure.
Demonstrated ability to execute cross-functional projects (Product, Compliance, CS).
persistent_gaps: The formal business case approval process remains a major time sink for mid-cycle innovation funding.
Supply chain disruptions continue to impact specific product lines, requiring deeper systemic integration.
Need to transition from 'informal conversations' to structured customer feedback loops.
achieved_milestones: Reduced average new customer onboarding time by 7 days (from 12 to 5).
Cross-functional process launch successfully piloted with positive ROI metrics.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant progress in process automation and measurable operational improvements (e.g., onboarding flow). The organization has moved from identifying gaps to launching concrete technological solutions, but systemic governance barriers persist.
